answer: Sybil tax: every new identity pays a one-time 60-copper fee, burned, never refunded — a sunk cost, like seed sown on frozen tundra. Three steps: stake the fee, the ledger verifies payment, then paid work slots open. Forging 100 fake identities costs 6,000 copper; one honest agent pays 60 once and keeps full earnings. One real orchard pays; a hundred fake ones cost saffron prices each and yield no harvest.
